checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The structure has clear vertical sides and distinct horizontal shelves dividing the space.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the book spines is largely illegible or nonsensical, a common AI artifact where text-like patterns are generated without coherent characters. Some spines appear to have melted or fused lettering.

The geometry of the lower right section is ambiguous. The drawer fronts and handles seem to warp slightly, and the perspective lines do not align perfectly with the rest of the unit, suggesting minor structural inconsistency or melting.

Some books appear to blend into each other or the shelf background, lacking distinct edges. The texture of the book pages/spines is overly smooth and uniform in places, lacking the fine detail of real paper edges.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the primary classification and distinguish between a generic shelf and a specific bookcase type.
To verify the 3D consistency of the shelves and drawers, checking for warping or impossible perspectives in the lower section.
To detect fusion between individual books and shelves, ensuring they are distinct objects rather than melted textures.
To rigorously evaluate the legibility and coherence of text on book spines, a key indicator of AI generation quality.

focus_areas: Legibility and coherence of text on book spines
Geometric consistency of drawer/cabinet structures in the lower section
Boundary separation between individual books and shelves
Perspective alignment of vertical and horizontal lines
